Resolves #21322

🌿 Charts, Canvas & Maps now opens on a map of its own, and a cover taken before that map's tiles are drawn can no longer happen.

The group publishes its first home card: OpenStreetMaps, with a dark cover made by recipe. The OpenStreetMaps addon marks its map element `data-rendered` (`false` on `loadstart`, `true` on `rendercomplete`). The recipe waits on that, so three runs wrote one byte-identical cover. The map example lists the dark theme first, as `grid/bigData` does. `canvas` draws nothing and `cesium-js` fails to load, so both records leave the catalog; their folders stay. The group's sentence now names what the page shows. The cover's bytes are in neomjs/pages#108.

Evidence: L3 (the producer's capture against the served example with live tiles, the Portal rendered before and after with the new bytes, one cold reader) → L3 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-4). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI: `MainContainerController.spec.mjs` pins charts at `[1, 1]` and its page as `offscreen-canvas`, `open-street-maps`. Outside CI: the after frames in the sheet below |
| AC-2 | Outside CI: three `--family charts` runs, 102,845 bytes, sha256 `bdd60440e148…d7fb` each |
| AC-3 | CI: `OpenStreetMaps.spec.mjs` › "the map element says when every tile of the view is drawn, and forgets it when its map is removed": `false` from the map's creation, `true` on `rendercomplete`, `false` on `loadstart`, and gone after `removeMap()` (`c1d9a95b57`). On the code before that commit it fails at the first assertion (`undefined`, not `false`) |
| AC-4 | Outside CI: the sheet and the cold look below |
| AC-5 | CI: the catalog spec counts 97 records. `examples/component/canvas` and `examples/component/wrapper/cesiumJS` are untouched |
| AC-6 | neomjs/pages#108 carries the cover, same sha256 |
| AC-7 | Outside CI: the whole unit suite at `8c675ef2b1`, 7,954 passed, 2 skipped |

## Deltas from ticket

- The group sentence (`apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainer.mjs`) promised "a pie chart, canvas and WebGL scenes, a globe": none of them publishes after this change. It now names the two cards. The group's second leaf widens it again as its examples land.
- The graph scene moved to the group's second leaf before this PR opened; the ticket body says why.

## Test Evidence

The Charts, Canvas & Maps page before (`dev` `0128668721`) and after (`5f2c4e3e32`), at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, dark, and the cover at 340 px: 

![The Charts, Canvas & Maps page before and after, at 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844, and the cover at 340 px](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/bd145f13ec5b720fb00144e078f66c7397ede5d2/review-evidence/21322/look.png?raw=true)
. The production build reads covers from pages' `main`, so both runs served those requests from neomjs/pages#108's checkout; "before" came from a server that answers the catalog and the group file as `dev` has them.

## Cold look

One cold reader of this seat (a front-end engineer evaluating component libraries; unlabelled versions X = before and Y = after, both sizes): **before 4/10, after 6/10, "Y is better."** Before is "thin and slightly misleading": one card under "1 from other groups", and a sentence naming a pie chart, WebGL and a globe the page does not show. After: "two different demos … and a subtitle that matches them".

Its other notes belong to other lanes: the OffscreenCanvas cover still shows a browser window (that record's home is Workers & Platform); the empty band above the cards, the count cue ("1" beside two cards), the cut phone caption and the missing open cue belong to the Shell lane (#21325). An earlier read graded both versions alike: the first sheet's "before" came out as "after", because the Portal's SharedWorker bypassed the page route. The sheet at `bd145f13ec` serves `dev`'s files from a second server instead.
